as_told.title: Ambush with shots fired on the next mission

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber, who says he helped retrieve a UFO with his helicopter, tells Michels that on another of these recovery missions "shots were fired". He tells it as something he was part of, once in 2025 and again in 2026, and in the later telling he calls it an ambush.
